Q: A system emits a pattern of power-on self-test (POST) beeps and shows no video. What does this indicate?
Option2: Firmware error codes pointing to failing hardware such as memory or video

Q: Which symptom best matches a blue screen of death (BSOD) or endless pinwheel?
Option2: Operating system crash, often caused by driver or hardware faults

Q: What does a black screen with fans spinning usually suggest first?
Option2: No video due to failed graphics adapter or memory seating; check connections and components

Q: A desktop has 'no power'—no fans or lights. First check?
Option2: Verify power cable, power strip, rear voltage selector, and power supply unit (PSU) switch
Option4: Change Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) scope

Q: Which issues most commonly cause sluggish performance?
Option2: Insufficient memory or background processes consuming CPU and storage input/output

Q: A system randomly shuts down under load. Which is most likely?
Option1: Improper thermal paste or cooling causing overheating and automatic protection

Q: What does a burning smell from inside a PC usually indicate?
Option2: Electrical short or overheating component - power off and inspect

Q: What does intermittent shutdown often point to?
Option1: Loose power or thermal issues such as a failing power supply or overheating

Q: Frequent application crashes after a recent graphics driver update suggest what?
Option2: Driver instability - roll back or update to a vendor-approved version

Q: Which symptom indicates capacitor swelling on a motherboard?
Option2: Bulging or leaking capacitor tops leading to instability

Q: Inaccurate system date and time after each power loss usually points to what?
Option2: Exhausted complementary metal-oxide semiconductor (CMOS) battery on the motherboard

Q: What is the best first step when a system gives memory errors at boot?
Option2: Reseat memory modules, test with known-good memory, and run memory diagnostics

Q: Which issue can cause black screen immediately after adding a new CPU?
Option2: Incompatible firmware or unsupported CPU requiring a firmware update

Q: Which symptom aligns with 'no power' due to a faulty case power button?
Option2: Front-panel header miswire preventing the power switch from signaling the motherboard
Option4: Power-on self-test (POST) beeps indicate memory error

Q: A desktop makes a constant grinding noise and temperatures are rising. Most likely cause?
Option2: Failing case or CPU fan bearings - replace the fan and check airflow; inspect the power supply fan as well
